concept: Secrets Manager: automatic rotation of DB credentials
tests: Choosing a service to store DB credentials with automatic rotation and secure retrieval at runtime.
expected: AWS Secrets Manager with rotation enabled (Lambda rotation, built in for RDS). Triggers: "automatic rotation", "database credentials", "minimal operational overhead".
why_not: Parameter Store standard parameters — no built-in rotation; an encrypted S3 object and KMS data keys — no rotation at all, custom code needed.
